title: What stangent-link-judge returns with fsd.groupSections and fsd.judgeFinerVerdicts on (C.4, C.6, D124)
description: The link judge output, for a run of neighbouring sections: each link names its own section, and code checks its quote against that section alone.

section.description: The id of the section this link's FSD sentence comes from, as listed.

fsdQuote.description: Copied exactly from the FSD section (agree, conflict, gap).

page.description: A candidate page's id (agree, conflict, undocumented; optional for gap).

statement.description: The page statement's id, e.g. R3.

pageQuote.description: Copied exactly from that statement (agree, conflict, undocumented).

covered.description: partial: what the statement does show.

note.description: Why. On unclear, the reason it can't be told.
